title: perf(metadata-protocol): one form request reads the view list and each type's stored rows once
body:
Fixes #37709

Clause-②: yes (widening) — ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.readFormRequest
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:匿名公开表单页和按名读取表单时,返回的内容与以前完全一样,只是同一次请求里不再把同一批元数据反复读好几遍。
- 属于"表单独立成为元数据类型"这一系列的收尾,解决上一轮评审留下的"同一请求重复读库"这一条遗留项。
- 若出错,公开表单可能打不开或判断错一个表单是否公开;改动不碰任何存储数据,可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

The effective `form` read (ADR-0159 D5) resolves over both types: the generic `form` list, the projection of the `view` list, and the cross-type resolution (step 3) over the stored rows of both types. Each of those readings, and each of the five reads an anonymous form door makes, asked the store for the same rows again.

- **`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-form-reads.ts`.** `formRequestScope(host)`: one request's reading, over which each stored row set (per type and package binding) and each flattened list (per request, audience and layer) is read once. `readEffectiveFormList` reads through it, so the generic `form` list and step 3 share one reading of the `form` rows, and the `view` list and step 3 share one reading of the `view` rows. `readInFormRequest(read)` runs `read` as one request reading (an AsyncLocalStorage store): every protocol list read inside it over the same host shares one scope, and once `read` settles the scope memoizes nothing, so nothing outlives the request. The stored rows of step 3 stay read whole (a container row's name is not the name its expansion writes); they are read once per request. The `readEffectiveFormList` docblock now states that.
- **`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-list-reads.ts`.** `readFlattenedMetaItems` takes an optional stored-row reader (the scope's); `getMetaItems` and `getMetaItemsPerPackage` read through the open request reading when there is one; the package-scoped `form` list face reads its envelope through the same scope.
- **`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`.** The private `readFlattenedMetaItems` passes the row reader on. New server-only extension `readFormRequest(read)` (feature-detected by the doors, like `getMetaItemsPerPackage` and `getUnreadableFormBodies`): runs `read` as one request reading.
- **`packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts`** (outside the claim's file surface; the measured producer of the repeated door reads, see Acceptance notes). `resolveFormBySlug` makes its five reads inside `readFormRequest` when the protocol serves it, and exactly as before otherwise. Both doors (`GET /forms/:slug`, `POST /forms/:slug/submit`) go through it.
- **`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`.** Comment only at `readEffectiveFormItem`: on this tree it calls `readEffectiveForms` once (not up to three times), and that one call now reads each row set once.

Every answer is unchanged: the same items, in the same order, from the same served-row order. The ADR-0159 D5 cross-type resolution is untouched; `names` and `packageId` handling is untouched (`names` was already pushed into both generic reads, and the reason `packageId` is not pushed down was already stated in the `readEffectiveFormList` docblock, both landed in #37422's rework; confirmed on this tree, not redone).

### Measured counts (real protocol, real `ObjectQL` + SQLite store, `OS_METADATA_OVERLAY_CACHE_TTL_MS=0`, one warm-up request)

"Row-set read" = one `readActiveOverlayRows` call (one `sys_metadata` statement under the singular type, plus one under the plural when the singular answers no row).

| Request | Form shape | `view` list (effective) before → after | `view` row sets before → after | `form` row sets before → after |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| by-name `form` read | authored `form` item | 1 → 1 | 2 → 1 | 2 → 1 |
| by-name `form` read | old-shape `formViews` entry | 1 → 1 | 1 → 1 | 1 → 1 |
| form-door GET | authored `form` item | 2 → 1 | 5 → 1 | 3 → 1 |
| form-door GET | old-shape `formViews` entry | 2 → 1 | 4 → 1 | 2 → 1 |

Before = `origin/main` 93fa9118a (with #37422 merged); after = this branch. The by-name read also issues one row read predicated on the name (the generic by-name read's own, `readItemActiveRows`), before and after. The door reads the `form` list, the per-package `form` layer and the per-package `view` layer once each, before and after. With the row cache on (default 30 s) the repeated reads were cache hits at the SQL level, but each still ran its parse and merge; with it off (or on a cold or invalidated cache) each was a statement.

## Tests

- New `packages/rest/src/public-form-reads-once-37709.test.ts` (8 cases, both form shapes): the by-name read and the door GET read the `view` list once and each type's row sets once (exact counts, answers asserted); CONTROL 1, two requests read twice (the scope never spans requests); CONTROL 2, the five door calls outside one reading (a protocol without `readFormRequest`) read the `view` list twice and the `view` rows four times, so the counter sees a repeated read when there is one.
- `packages/rest/src/rest-write-route-hook-refusal-sentence.ledger.test.ts`: its catch-all protocol double rejects every method it does not list, and the door now feature-detects `readFormRequest`, so the double's reads table gains one pass-through entry, as it gained `getMetaItemsPerPackage` and `getUnreadableFormBodies` when those door extensions landed. No assertion changed. Every other form-door and D5 test is unchanged and green.

- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` `vitest run`: Test Files 372 passed, 9 skipped (381); Tests 23605 passed, 45 skipped.
- `@objectstack/rest` `vitest run --project local`: Test Files 433 passed (433); Tests 8981 passed, 351 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck`: exit 0.
- Final head 73983efb0 changes only `protocol.ts` text after that run (the `readFlattenedMetaItems` docblock reflowed and the new method's docblock made one line, so the facade stays at its 11705-line ceiling, `check:facade-delegation-only`). On it: rebuilt, both typechecks exit 0, and the pin plus 11 form-door files: Test Files 12 passed (12), Tests 898 passed (898).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations on 6178fb1fb (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, each leg built and checked in dist with scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs)</summary>

- A1, the effective `form` read without its scope (drop `host = formRequestScope(host)` in `readEffectiveFormList`): 2 failed / 6 passed (the by-name read of an authored `form` item, and CONTROL 1).
- A2, `readFormRequest` opens no reading (`readInFormRequest(read)` replaced by calling `read` directly): 4 failed / 4 passed (the door GET in both shapes, and CONTROL 1 in both).
- A3, the scope's list reads read their rows outside it (no row reader passed): 6 failed / 2 passed.

</details>

<details><summary>Local gates on 73983efb0 (the 75 families `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives for this diff)</summary>

- All 75 commands exit 0, each exit captured before any pipe. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3: it reads every package's `dist/`), and exit 0 when re-run after `check:type-check-debt`'s full build on the same head (126 require entry points across 74 packages load).
- `check:facade-delegation-only` held the line: `protocol.ts` is at its 11705-line ceiling (it went red at 11719 on f97bc7d66, fixed in 73983efb0).
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 75 derived, 75 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Raw control-byte self-scan of the changed files: no match.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Landing point outside the claim's file surface: `packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts`.** Measurement shows the door's repeated `view`-list and row reads come from its five separate protocol calls; no change inside `packages/metadata-protocol` alone can share a reading across them. A first cut answered the five reads through one new protocol call; it bypassed the doubles four existing door tests install by overriding `getMetaItems` / `getMetaItemsPerPackage` / `getUnreadableFormBodies` on a real protocol, so the door keeps its five calls and runs them inside one request reading instead.
- **Premise check.** On 93fa9118a `readEffectiveFormItem` calls `readEffectiveForms` once (the card's "up to three times" no longer holds); the repeats were inside that one call (the `form` and `view` row sets twice each).
- **New seam worth a reviewer's eye:** `readFormRequest` is a new public method on `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` (server-only, feature-detected), and `metadata-protocol` now uses `AsyncLocalStorage` (`node:async_hooks`; the package is already node-only).

## Verification

First read, by risk:
1. `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-form-reads.ts`, `formRequestScope` and `readInFormRequest`: a memoized list is one object handed to several callers in the same request (every caller reads it, none writes it), and the `live()` check that stops memoizing once the request settles.
2. `packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts`, `resolveFormBySlug`: the five reads inside `inOneReading`, in their old order.
3. `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-list-reads.ts`: `readRows` at the active-row read of `readFlattenedMetaItems`, and `inFormRequestScope` in `getMetaItems` / `getMetaItemsPerPackage`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/public-form-reads-once-37709.test.ts` prints `Tests  8 passed (8)`.
